title: The Mountain Where Breath Comes Short

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After climbing a steep hill, a villager wonders whether there are mountains so high that people struggle to breathe.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After climbing a steep hill, (name1) wonders whether there are mountains so high that people struggle to breathe.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager imagines mountains that touch the clouds and feels dizzy just thinking about it.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A scholar wonders how anyone would live so high.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests people born in such places might find the air there perfectly normal.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child imagines them visiting Isola and finding the air thick and sleepy.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers reach the top and feel on top of the world.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They stop halfway, decide the view is good enough, and have lunch.
